Findings (1)
  CRITICAL  entry 0  SHA-1 signature [sig.sha1]
            The certificate or certificate signing request is signed with SHA-1, which is no longer collision resistant. Current software rejects SHA-1 certificate signatures, and a CA should refuse a SHA-1-signed request. On a self-signed CA certificate the signature is not checked when that certificate is used as a trust anchor, so there it is informational.
            Evidence: signature_algorithm=SHA1-RSA
            Fix: Reissue the certificate, or create a new certificate signing request, with a SHA-256 or stronger signature.
